readings: Inner-join signals to telescopes and observatories, dropping signals that don't match. Compute the average modulation index and average phase shift for each (telescope, weathprofile) group. Compute the overall average modulation index as the average over all individual joined signals. Keep the groups whose average modulation index is above that overall value. Then, for each weathprofile, report the unweighted mean of the kept groups' average modulation indexes, the unweighted mean of their average phase shifts, and the mean of (group average modulation index minus the overall average). Don't round anything.

Inner-join signals to telescopes and observatories, dropping signals that don't match. Compute the average modulation index and average phase shift for each (telescope, weathprofile) group. Compute the overall average modulation index as the average of the group-level average modulation indexes, so each group counts equally. Keep the groups whose average modulation index is above that overall value. Then, for each weathprofile, report the unweighted mean of the kept groups' average modulation indexes, the unweighted mean of their average phase shifts, and the mean of (group average modulation index minus the overall average). Don't round anything.

Inner-join signals to telescopes and observatories, dropping signals that don't match. Compute the average modulation index and average phase shift for each (telescope, weathprofile) group. Compute the overall average modulation index as the average over all individual joined signals. Keep the groups whose average modulation index is above that overall value. Then, for each weathprofile, pool all individual signals from the kept groups. Report the average modulation index and the average phase shift over those pooled signals, and the difference between the pooled average modulation index and the overall average. Don't round anything.

Compute the overall average modulation index as the average of the group-level average modulation indexes, so each group counts equally. Keep the groups whose average modulation index is above that overall value. Then, for each weathprofile, pool all individual signals from the kept groups. Report the average modulation index and the average phase shift over those pooled signals, and the difference between the pooled average modulation index and the overall average. Don't round anything.
queries:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.telescref AS tel, o.weathprofile AS wp, s.modindex AS mi, s.phaseshiftdeg AS ps
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(mi) AS overall_avg FROM joined
),
grp AS (
  SELECT tel, wp, AVG(mi) AS avg_mi, AVG(ps) AS avg_ps
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY tel, wp
)
SELECT g.wp AS weathprofile,
       AVG(g.avg_mi) AS mean_avg_modindex,
       AVG(g.avg_ps) AS mean_avg_phaseshift,
       AVG(g.avg_mi - ov.overall_avg) AS mean_modindex_diff_from_overall
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN overall ov
WHERE g.avg_mi > ov.overall_avg
GROUP BY g.wp;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry AS tel, o.weathprofile AS wp,
         AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
ov AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall FROM g
)
SELECT g.wp AS weathprofile,
       AVG(g.avg_mod) AS mean_avg_modindex,
       AVG(g.avg_phase) AS mean_avg_phaseshift,
       AVG(g.avg_mod - ov.overall) AS mean_modindex_diff
FROM g, ov
WHERE g.avg_mod > ov.overall
GROUP BY g.wp;
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.telescref AS telescope, o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, s.modindex AS modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg AS phaseshiftdeg
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM joined
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT telescope, weathprofile
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY telescope, weathprofile
  HAVING AVG(modindex) > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall)
)
SELECT j.weathprofile,
       AVG(j.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
       AVG(j.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift,
       AVG(j.modindex) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall) AS diff_from_overall
FROM joined j
INNER JOIN kept_groups k ON j.telescope = k.telescope AND j.weathprofile = k.weathprofile
GROUP BY j.weathprofile;
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.telescref AS telescope, o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, s.modindex AS modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg AS phaseshiftdeg
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
grp AS (
  SELECT telescope, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY telescope, weathprofile
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg_mod FROM grp
),
kept AS (
  SELECT telescope, weathprofile
  FROM grp
  WHERE avg_mod > (SELECT overall_avg_mod FROM overall)
)
SELECT j.weathprofile,
       AVG(j.modindex) AS pooled_avg_modindex,
       AVG(j.phaseshiftdeg) AS pooled_avg_phaseshift,
       AVG(j.modindex) - (SELECT overall_avg_mod FROM overall) AS diff_from_overall
FROM joined j
JOIN kept k ON j.telescope = k.telescope AND j.weathprofile = k.weathprofile
GROUP BY j.weathprofile;
